items.label: Task
items.title: Understanding the task
keyPoints: Underline the topic words in the question.
Identify the instruction: agree, discuss, or solve.
Answer every part of the question.

items.label: Paraphrase
items.title: Paraphrasing the question
keyPoints: Replace key words with accurate synonyms.

items.label: Thesis
items.title: Writing a thesis
keyPoints: State your opinion in one clear sentence.
Keep the same position until the conclusion.

items.label: Intro formula
items.title: Writing introductions
keyPoints: Paraphrase the question in one sentence.
Outline the two ideas you will develop.

items.label: Conclusions
items.title: Writing conclusions
keyPoints: Restate your position with new wording.
Never add a new idea in the conclusion.

items.label: Practice
items.title: Putting it together
keyPoints: Plan for five minutes before writing.
Write one idea per body paragraph.
Leave three minutes to check your work.
